name: Fixture Platform Endeavour
description: Exercises pattern orchestration: two patterns sequenced into the shape of a whole endeavour, with entry and exit criteria and a narrative template.

patterns.name: Bootstrap the Platform
patterns.description: Bringing a shared foundation into existence for the first time.

patternViews.name: Agree the Need
patternViews.description: Establish that a shared foundation is worth building.

narrativeContexts.context: Every team builds its own foundation and the duplication is visible.

patternViews.name: Stand It Up
patternViews.description: Build the foundation and let a team use it.

narrativeContexts.context: The first golden path is built and proved with a willing team.

patterns.name: Run the Platform
patterns.description: Keeping the foundation healthy once teams depend on it.

patternViews.name: Operate
patternViews.description: Carry production workloads within agreed bounds.

patternViews.name: Improve
patternViews.description: Act on what operating the platform reveals.

loopsBackTo.description: Each improvement returns the platform to normal running.

patternOrchestrations.name: Platform Endeavour
patternOrchestrations.description: The whole life of a platform, from first build through steady-state running.

exitCriteria.name: Platform is usable
exitCriteria.description: Whether the platform can carry a real workload unaided.
when: a team deploys a production workload to it
then: the workload runs without intervention by the platform team

narrativeContexts.context: Prove a shared foundation is worth having before asking anyone to depend on it.
Teams ship on the shared foundation and the platform team runs it.
